newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK RESERVES RISE IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK RESERVES RISE IN JULY.

text.p: The central bank said on Thursday that its official reserves rose to $1.153 billion by the end of July compared with $834 million at the end of 1996.
The central bank's reserves at the end of June were $939.6 million.
It said in a statement that it had gold reserves of $62.1 million, unchanged from the previous month.
Its convertible currency reserves came to $1.086 billion versis $859.1 million at the end of June.
Its had 5.1 million of SDRs versus 18.4 million the previous month.
